concerns.text: T017b (Validate processed data against schema) is listed AFTER T014 (Imputation/Normalization) and T016 (Normalization/Feature subsets). However, T014 and T016 produce the data that T017b validates. The task description for T017b says 'Depends on T004b, T014', but the ordering in the list places T017b after T016a/b. While T017b is after T014, it is also after T016a/b which are part of the same 'preprocess.py' logic block. More critically, T017b is listed *after* T018 (Save final processed dataset). Validation MUST occur BEFORE saving the final artifact to ensure the saved file is valid. T017b must precede T018.

T015 (Degenerate Dataset Check) is listed after T014 (Imputation) but before T016 (Normalization). The task description states it runs 'immediately after T014'. However, T015 writes a flag file and exits with code 0. If T015 exits, subsequent tasks in Phase 3 (T016, T017, T018) cannot run. The ordering implies a linear sequence where T016 runs after T015, which is impossible if T015 exits. The task list must reflect that T015 is a conditional gate that halts the sequence if triggered, or T016/T017/T018 must be explicitly marked as 'Skipped if T015 triggers'.

T035 (Separate Model Comparison) depends on T030 (Load selected model) and T031 (SHAP values). However, T035 explicitly requires comparing 'X_raw' and 'X_derived' models. T030 only loads the *selected* model (either raw or derived). To perform the comparison described in T035, the system must have access to *both* models and their respective SHAP values. T030/T031 only generate artifacts for the *selected* model. The tasks to generate SHAP values and metrics for the *non-selected* model (the one discarded in T028) are missing from the sequence. T035 cannot execute as described because the required artifacts for the non-selected model do not exist.

T054 (Contract Test Execution) is listed in Phase 7 with a dependency on T004b and T018. However, T054 is marked as [P] (parallel-safe) in Phase 7, but it is a test that validates the output of T018. In Phase 3, T054 was listed as a test task. In Phase 7, it is listed as an execution task. The ordering is confusing: T054 should be executed as part of the validation of T018 (Phase 3) or as a final check in Phase 7. If it is a final check, it depends on T018 (Phase 3) and T004b (Phase 2). The [P] tag is appropriate for the test itself, but the dependency chain needs to be clear that it runs *after* T018 is complete, which it does in Phase 7. The main issue is the duplication of T054 in Phase 3 (as a test task) and Phase 7 (as an execution task). The Phase 3 entry is marked [X] (completed) but Phase 7 entry is [ ] (pending). This creates ambiguity on when the test is actually run.
